title: Proof-Carrying Symbolic Forcing-Front CA
novelty_claim: Treat the verifier's product-grid witness as the automaton substrate itself: each cell stores exact symbolic span and certificate state, and a translation-invariant local rule proposes only verifier-legal edge labels, glue decisions, and seed data. The direction is only valid if candidates compile directly to exact (X,G,R,T) witnesses without repair.
closest_prior_art: Hand-built arithmetic Kakeya constructive witnesses and forcing-pair encodings
Generic automated mathematical search systems such as AlphaEvolve-style discovery loops
Neural or growing cellular automata used as black-box pattern generators
differentiation: The search space is the stage-indexed constructibility representation rather than an arbitrary graph, the state is proof-aware rather than heuristic, and every claim is filtered through exact integer verification plus label-shuffle and out-of-distribution controls.
easiest_falsifier: Any score advantage disappears after exact Z decoding, under X-label shuffling at fixed geometry, or on held-out larger or different-aspect-ratio constructible grids.
evidence_plan: Run a small exact-verifier sweep on tiny d1xd2 and d1xd2xd3 instances with fixed legal X and proof-aware CA states.
Compare hit rate and score distribution against random local search and whole-witness mutation with matched decode budget.
Require out-of-size generalization and label-shuffle collapse before promotion.

budget_envelope.candidate_limit: At most 3 local-rule families and 10^3 exact decodes per family before review.
mandatory_controls: X-label shuffle at fixed geometry and fixed nonzero-label multiset
Random/local-mutation and whole-witness baselines with matched exact-decode budget
Held-out larger or different-aspect-ratio grids and at least one different valid alphabet X
budget_envelope.promotion_gate: Promote only if the exact verified score distribution improves and the signal collapses under label shuffling.

title: Sparse-Defect Amplifier CA on a Recursive Background
novelty_claim: Generate most of the constructible witness with a low-description-complexity background CA, then use a second local channel to insert rare, locally justified defects whose only role is to create isolated verifier-usable certificates. This targets the underexplored middle regime between periodic families and ad hoc gadget placement.
closest_prior_art: Minor tweaks of known small recursive arithmetic Kakeya gadgets
Quality-diversity and open-ended search over cellular systems
Unconstrained local mutation around low-complexity backgrounds
differentiation: Defects are allowed only if each defect type comes with a bounded-radius symbolic justification, and the objective is the full verifier-visible score rather than aesthetic regularity, defect count, or proxy propagation.
easiest_falsifier: Density-matched random perturbations or hand-placed certificate patches perform just as well once full score accounting uses m(G)+|R| over n(G)-|T|.
evidence_plan: Choose a very small family of background rules and defect grammars on the recursive constructibility representation.
Hold total edge density roughly fixed while varying defect density and grammar under exact verification.
Compare against the same background with no defects and against random perturbations of equal density.

budget_envelope.scope: Backup lane only after the champion is killed or stalls cleanly.
budget_envelope.candidate_limit: At most 2 background rules, 3 defect grammars, and 10^3 exact decodes total before keep-or-kill.
budget_envelope.promotion_gate: Promote only if sparse defects outperform both the clean background and random perturbations under exact verified score.

title: Flow-Firing Exact Forcing Decoder
novelty_claim: Compile a legal constructible graph into a fixed flow-firing or abelian-network local-dynamics system and use odometer-style invariants only as a ranking prior, with every candidate decoded back into exact legal R,T growth. This stays non-derivative only if the invariant predicts verifier-visible forcing better than trivial graph statistics.
closest_prior_art: Analogy-driven local-dynamics interpretations of additive proofs
differentiation: The compiler and decoder must be fixed in advance, label-aware, and exact; the direction is discarded if odometer features merely track depth, degree, or layer position.
easiest_falsifier: Odometer or sink features fail to predict exact T-growth better than raw graph depth or degree, or the signal survives X-label shuffling.
evidence_plan: Use one fixed compiler and one fixed decoder on a small benchmark slice of legal constructible graphs.
Test whether odometer features forecast exact forcing outcomes better than raw graph features.
Stop immediately if no predictive gap appears under exact verification.

budget_envelope.candidate_limit: One compiler, one decoder, and one small benchmark slice before stop-or-promote.
budget_envelope.promotion_gate: Promote only if the invariant predicts exact forcing substantially better than trivial graph baselines.
